name: Recraft V4
description: Recraft's design model: text rendering, brand colours, vectors. Text to image only on fal, so it works in "Generate new", not in Generate. Model id from fal's model index on 2026-09-11; the adapter is written from the provider's schema and has not run against the live API yet. Also on OpenRouter.

fal.note: Text to image only, and the endpoint takes neither a seed nor an output format: both are left out of the request. fal-ai/recraft/v4/pro/text-to-image is the pro tier of the same model.

openrouter.note: Runs on OpenRouter (one key for many models); the adapter has run against the live API with GPT Image 2.5, this model not yet. Only the prompt goes to OpenRouter, which passes it to Recraft. OpenRouter lists one input picture for this model but does not say whether it is edited or only used as a style reference, so this variant makes images from the prompt alone: it works in "Generate new", not in Generate; the dialog's aspect is sent as the closest preset. No seed and no size: the host picks the output size from the aspect. recraft/recraft-v4-pro is the pro tier of the same model.

magnificsub.note: Runs on your Magnific plan (Premium, Premium+ or Pro) through Magnific's MCP server (mcp.magnific.com), after signing in under Settings › API providers; each run spends the plan's credits, the same balance as Magnific's web app, and the status line says how many. The pictures are uploaded to Magnific (Freepik Company S.L., Málaga, Spain) as hidden uploads; the results are Magnific creations and show in your Magnific library. Not run against the live service with this model yet. Magnific's Recraft V4 (images_generate), Generate new only: it takes pictures as style references only, so it cannot edit a crop. The shown reference layers (at most 12) go as style pictures, which the prompt cannot name. The aspect ratio is the model's closest to the asked size; the model picks the pixel size.
